titulo: We Simulated 10,000 Games of Monopoly. One Color Wins Twice as Often

falas: In 1904, a woman named Lizzie Magie patented a board game.
It was built to prove one thing. Landlords get rich, and everyone else goes broke.
About thirty years later, a version of her idea became Monopoly.
That same year, Parker Brothers bought her patent.
For five hundred dollars.
And people have been arguing about how to win it ever since.
So we stopped arguing. We built the game in code, with every rule.
And we let a computer play it. Ten thousand times.
Every roll.
Every rent.
Every bankruptcy.
Four players. Every game played to the end, until one player owned everything.
And the results don't match what most people believe about this game.
By the end of this video, you'll know the one color set that wins half its games,
the famous set that quietly loses,
and what you should really do in jail.
